label: D2 after choosing a2 and reaching S2 (common a2->S2), late in the episode (trials ~55-89)
explanation: Fires only at D2 (100% of mass) and almost only when this trial chose a2 and reached S2 via the common transition (99.8% of mass; ~0 on a1 or rare transitions). Bare D2 & a2 & S2 has recall 0.997 but precision 0.27. The extra selectivity is episode time: silent before trial ~30, peaks at trials 60-79, silent at 90-99 (likely tracks drift in the hidden state across the episode, not a task variable). Requiring the previous choice to also be a2 (a stay) gives a small extra gain. Dev F1 0.77, mass recall 0.92. Magnitude is larger when the previous trial went unrewarded (prev_reward==0 trials hold 51% of mass on 33% of active steps; top activations ~0.95 follow an r0 D1). It does not fire at D1 or GO, after a1, or after a rare transition. All variables used are observed at D2.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over this trial (D2: a2 S2) and last trial (D2: a2 S2 u, a2 S2 r, a2 S1 u); timing cues that raise it most: phase=D2 & ep_dec=7, phase=D2 & ep_dec=6, phase=D2 & ep_dec=8.
